subject: ITC Mismatch Query - VWX Trading Co
message: Hi, we noticed there is a mismatch in our Input Tax Credit claim for Q2 FY26. GST portal shows Rs. 28,000 ITC available but we have claimed Rs. 35,000. Please review our GSTR-2B and advise us on the correct amount to claim. We need this clarification urgently before our September filing.
